messages:
Noah (product): Heads-up: Streaming Extensions v1 is GA on Hosted API. This adds structured streaming events, incremental function call frames, and schema validation hooks. Rolling to regions over 12h. Docs + migration steps: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/stream-ext

Priya (eng-runtime): Key changes: stream frames now include event.type (token|function_call|schema_error), and we send an initial capabilities frame. Backwards-compatible for clients that only read raw token stream.

Iris (docs): Updated reference and examples for Node/Python. New SDK helper: client.streamWithSchema() in @redwood/client v2.4.0. Please update example repos.

Noah (product): Policy change: function/tool invocation remains OFF by default for new orgs. Admin toggle in Console: "Enable Streaming Tools". Existing orgs keep current settings. This reduces accidental tool access during early adoption.

Sam (support): For customers asking about the toggle: if they enable and need audit logs, point them at Console -> Security -> Tool Audit. We're shipping a 7-day sample retention by default.

Priya (eng-runtime): New request header to opt-in per-request: X-RWD-Stream-Mode: evented|raw. Example curl for evented streaming (includes function schema):

```
curl -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/hosted/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-RWD-Stream-Mode: evented" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-stream-2","input":"Analyze this repo and call tools if needed","functions":[{"name":"list_files","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```

Priya (eng-runtime): Note: per-request opt-in still requires org-level enabling for function execution. We'll return a schema_error event if tools are requested but not enabled.

DeployBot: rollout:stream-ext v1 -> canary:eu-central-1 ✅ started at 1790124720, est complete 1790128920.

InfraBot: Observability: added stream-event count metric to Console (route: /hosted/generate). P95 stream latency dashboard tile live.

Sam (support): Action item for on-call/solutions: make sure customer-facing runbooks show how to toggle the Console setting and where to find audit logs. I'll open a gist.

Iris (docs): I'll publish a short migration checklist and update the changelog. Link will be posted here when live.

Noah (product): Thanks team  big launch. Please escalate any customer-impacting bugs to #eng-sre and tag me.
